source.description: Baseline source plus the recorded candidate transfer; this is not a final release commit.

sanitization: Only software test results are retained. Research paths, titles, source-file inventories, document content and screenshots are excluded.

checks.name: choosing text or a shape does not create an object; Escape also cancels an active drag
ellipse placement uses drag coordinates and persists the selected shape
reverse dragging normalizes the rectangle and Shift creates a circle
lines preserve reverse direction and Shift constrains the angle
text placement enters editing automatically and Backspace removes a character
object Delete, Undo and Redo change the real page file
shortCode is primary, old S aliases remain searchable and copy yields the shortCode
light and dark editor layouts remain visible at desktop and compact sizes

note: These eight checks ran in the development Electron host. They are not renamed or represented as final packaged-EXE checks.
